confirmed: Real compound/unit-bearing response parser compatibility was corrected.
The actual 60-query capability sweep has 53 nonempty parseable replies and 7 empty replies retained as unknown.
Every decoded TX packet in the ten stages is an exact known read query; zero writes.
No socket RX datagram was recorded during the captured 200 ms and auto-poll-off timeout windows.
Auto-poll-off leaves heartbeat and all 18 mandatory external reads active.
not_determined: Physical wire loss versus device firmware scheduling versus other network/OS causes of missing socket replies.
A causal polling-rate explanation: scheduler timeout counts 5/2/1/1 used different request counts, one nonrandomized run per condition, and different command mixes.
Laser emission, HV activation, optical timing or external pump operation were not tested by these read-only stages.
